name: Color Clash
author: Addicting Games
description: Color Clash is a free mobile shooting game. Color Clash is one of those free games that rests between competing genres of mobile games. On one hand, it is a shooting game where patience and aim are required in order to effectively line up a shot. On the other hand, this is a game that requires you to solve each level like a puzzle. In this game, you aren't taking a shot at a specific target. Instead, you will be trying to launch your round in such a way that it manages to hit and bounce off of successive walls and barriers in such a way that you are able to hit all of the barriers with one shot. This makes each level a puzzle. A puzzle you solve by taking aim and firing. There is only one solution per level and even once you find the right place to aim you'll need to find the right amount of momentum to fire with. Color Clash truly is a riddle inside of an enigma inside of a mystery.
